items.prompt: A loop rejects nonpositive integer quantities. What must happen before an accepted-total update?
items.explanation: The rejection check must precede the update, with a branch that prevents rejected values from reaching it. The policy is explicit, not a universal trading rule.

options.text: Add every value, then just count the rejected records
options.why: Counting a bad record does not undo its contribution.

options.text: Replace all values with zero before checking their sign
options.why: That loses valid positive quantities as well.

options.text: Check the value and skip the update for rejected records
options.why: This preserves the stated accepted-total rule.

options.text: Return after reading the first quantity, valid or not
